capabilities: Write scripts in a .comic editor with pages, panels and lettering blocks
Drag and drop blocks, panels and pages to reorder them
Attach reference images to lines and float them while writing
Group issues into numbered projects with statistics
disambiguation: Not a drawing or layout tool for comic art; it only drafts the script text and exports it to Word.
extras: No network access and no telemetry. Needs Obsidian 1.5.7 or newer; settings appear in Obsidian's settings search on 1.13+. Reference images are kept out of the script and Word output unless the optional visual references appendix is enabled. Manual install requires main.js, manifest.json and styles.css in the plugin folder.
problem: Obsidian has no dedicated structure for comic scripts, so page, panel and balloon numbering and Word-ready formatting must be done by hand.

relations.evidence: A project keeps a series together, like Longform but simpler.

summary: Comic script editor with drag-and-drop pages, panels and lettering blocks, series projects, and export to editable Word files.
